title: Food delivery pricing: quotes that reach into the shared fee schedule
name: Delivery fee quotes

questions.prompt: Support tickets from Lisbon: after the Friday dinner rush, customers kept seeing doubled delivery fees long after dispatch turned surge off. Others got free delivery on a single coffee right after someone placed a big order. Couriers in the same zones say their pay per drop is all over the place. Restarting the pricing service fixes it for a while. Fix delivery/quote.ts so the tests pass.
